dependencyInstallNcclFromTheNvidiaDevelo: Wụnye NCCL site na NVIDIA saịtị Mmepụta. A na-eji NCCL maka nzikọrịta ozi ọtụtụ GPU.

dependencyInstallCudnnFromTheNvidiaDevel: Wụnye cuDNN site na NVIDIA ebe nrụpụta wee tinye DLL n'akụkụ ngwa ma ọ bụ na System32.
dependencyInstallCudnnViaTheNvidiaPackag: Wụnye cuDNN site na ebe nchekwa ngwugwu NVIDIA ma ọ bụ budata tarball wee detuo libs na /usr/local/cuda/lib64.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanRuntimeFromLun: Wụnye oge ọsọ Vulkan site na LunarG. Ọkwọ ụgbọala gị GPU nwere ike ịgụnye ya - buru ụzọ melite ọkwọ ụgbọ ala GPU gị.
dependencyInstallTheVulkanLoaderOnUbuntu: Wụnye ihe Vulkan loader: na Ubuntu/Debian: sudo apt install libvulkan1. Na Arch: sudo pacman -S vulkan-icd-loader. Na RHEL/Fedora: sudo dnf install vulkan-loader.
